verification.scope: Only assigned11–20 semantic blocks read. Full-file completion across all40batches is parent-owned. Source hash/reconstruction checks are mechanical, not claims of semantic reading of other blocks.

notes.findings: Zhangzara scatterbrain/signal/soft-editorial/stencil-tablet/studio/vellum preserve distinct audience/decision/evidence rubrics with authored house styles. HyperFrames hides editable sources and mandates scaffold/defaults; conflict with functional motion-design visible dual delivery. No house style or three-question gate generalized.

HyperFrames separates temporal track index from z-order and static layout from motion; deterministic clock is useful but exact framework duration/empty-tween rules conflict with functional motion route. Reject universal every-element entrance/no jump-cut/min-three-ease rules. IB pitch keeps per-number origin, freshness, rights and assumptions, no undisclosed invented data; source/provenance principles duplicate existing Ingenium.

Image-poster has fixed one-image-per-turn and host dispatcher rules: not general guidance. Invoice/kami/kanban are specific layouts. Kami typography/language semantics and rendered fallback distinctions useful, but fixed colors/fonts/5% accent and mandated questions rejected; zero dependencies versus Google Fonts requires qualification. Kanban draggable-looking affordance does not prove dragging. Last30days explicitly distinguishes checked/unavailable/thin sources; hiding exact setup failures rejected for this task.

Live-artifact explicitly separates canonical normalized data, template, provenance and derived index; list scopes and scalar bindings matter. Live-dashboard fallback to seeded mock after connector error must not masquerade as refreshed real data; toy scores/house-style and fixed template restrictions rejected. Mobile-app forces single-screen iPhone treatment even broad mobile scope; no multi-state coverage inferred. Onboarding/motion-frames fixed counts are designed examples.

Motion-frames falsely implies CSS-only automatically deterministic capture; CSS animation needs actual exporter clock qualification. Open-design landing/deck strongly parameterized finite library, single source CSS/shared assets; useful package-relative dependency verification, not16assets/eight-question/rhythm quotas. Orbit-general claims live connector digest while allowing refresh of mock data and fixed module/people counts; reject ignoring user brand/Figma and never infer user identity from examples.

Orbit general/GitHub/Gmail/Linear specify connector-shaped layouts and detailed fixture data. Identity guard useful duplicate; live-data descriptions do not establish queries or actual current activity. No exact row, fixed source org, mock timestamps, ignored brand tokens or copied chrome adopted. Data shape can help choose UI, but automatic inference is tentative and subject semantics remain authoritative.

Orbit Notion page/toggle remains specified; collapsed toggle does not prove expansion. PRD/pricing fixed quotas and plausible price assumption not factual data. Replit snapshot date/sampling scope distinguish authored source history from current/executed qualification; runtime/support/93%/iframe claims untested here. SaaS mentally simulate viewport self-check rejected as rendered evidence; template mandate and style quotas not Ingenium.

Simple-deck theme alternation contradicts taste theme lock; both are styles, reject universal ratios. Social carousel HTML preview at280–380px is not1080px export or loop video. Social dashboard instructs plausible metrics: synthetic label required. Matrix tracker expresses aligned arrays, units, shared index and metric synchronization; useful domain contract, not fixed chart counts. Sprite animation CSS mock is not completed video. Trading placeholders honestly separate unknown figures.

Tweaks optional controls can support comparison, per-artifact persistence and actual change/refresh loop useful. Reject paternalistic no free picker, knob quotas and unverified bounds; localStorage is not user acceptance. Host visibility handshake is environment-specific, not portable workflow. Video-shortform provider capabilities/cost claims unverified; no dispatch executed. Waitlist escaping/type-specific interpolation references are implementation constraints, not proof of sanitation; native validity/status feedback does not prove actual signup persistence.

Web prototype preserves selected real asset geometry and explicitly labels acquisition gaps; source/derived previews separate. Brutalist/editorial/soft templates contain incompatible style bans, forced typography/decoration and slow motion quotas: reject universal adoption. WebGL capability fallback, resize, shader errors and brightest-frame contrast are scoped domain checks; always60fps assertion unverified. Weekly deck is authored structure. Wireframe annotation pin-to-note mapping useful duplicate, lorem bars cannot verify real content/task semantics.
